paragraphs: Cree Lighting makes LED light fixtures for outdoor spaces. Its roadway range is sold for streets in cities and towns. Other lines are aimed at fuel stations, covering canopies, stores and car washes. Schools and universities are another named market.

Area lighting is one of the catalog categories, meant for parking lots, playgrounds and other large outdoor spaces. Fixtures can carry onboard controls, with each luminaire linked wirelessly to as many neighbors as possible. The company says buyers can expect a lifetime range of 50,000 to 100,000 hours. Warranties are limited and come in one, five and ten year terms. A warmer outdoor color option is promoted as a way to reduce the effect on wildlife such as migrating birds.

Product listings are grouped by the settings they serve, including cities and towns. Gas stations and convenience stores form another group. Listings also carry certification labels such as DarkSky approval. Others are tagged as designed, engineered and assembled in the USA. The canopy and soffit line is offered in multiple configurations.

quote.text: Our roadway portfolio lights cities and towns, from driveway to highway, with performance and visual comfort in mind.
